package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	request, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.test/pets", strings.NewReader("{\"name\":\"it's \\\"Rex\\\"\",\"n\":\"line\nbreak\",\"u\":\"é\"}"))
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	request.Header.Add("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Add("Authorization", "Bearer [redacted]")
	response, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	defer response.Body.Close()
	data, _ := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
	fmt.Println(response.StatusCode, string(data))
}
